name: The danger named by A’dal

date.label: Original Burning Crusade attunement quest era; exact date unknown

summary: Tempest Keep was made by the naaru, and A’dal says they had once judged a return unnecessary. Now Kael’thas must be stopped before he can use the Cipher of Damnation. A’dal asks adventurers to prove themselves in four trials before entering the vessel. The quests describe readiness for a dangerous undertaking; this story does not turn the achievement title into an office bestowed by the naaru.
